summary: Recruiting Coordinator with over 15 years of HR experience, specializing in background checks, new hire onboarding, benefits administration, and HRIS systems such as ADP, Taleo, and PeopleSoft.

Verify employment requests and process unemployment claims.
Enter benefit enrollments and onboard new hires in ADP Ev5 and SAP.
Manage monthly COBRA payments using Excel.
E-verify all new hires and process I-9 paperwork.

experience.title: Human Resources Temp

Managed background checks for physicians and nurses in ADP Select and EP Staff Check.
Processed I-9 documents and updated benefit information in ADP Enterprise.

experience.title: Recruiting Coordinator

Uploaded and tracked new hire paperwork in Taleo.
Maintained employee database reports in Excel.

experience.title: Administrative Assistant
responsibilities: Provided administrative support to the Department and Dean of Liberal Arts & Sciences.
Prepared communications, correspondence, and memos.
Maintained graduate award budget and compiled award data in Excel.

experience.title: Human Resources Communications and Staffing Specialist
responsibilities: Compiled HR news and maintained SharePoint intranet content.
Managed reports in Learning Management Systems and designed print media.
Assisted in developing employee training program materials.

experience.title: Recruiting Coordinator – Human Resources
